articles.title: Migration in Deutschland: Gut vier Millionen Geflüchtete und Vertriebene leben in Deutschland
articles.teaser: Über vier Millionen Menschen kamen wegen Flucht oder Vertreibung nach Deutschland. Viele der seit 1950 eingewanderten Geflüchteten stammen aus Syrien und der Ukraine.
articles.image_title: Migration in Deutschland: A resident walks through a container facility for refugees and asylum seekers located in aircraft hangars of the former Tempelhof airport in Berlin on August 14, 2025. Most 2015 arrivals have long moved out of emergency accommodation, but many camps remain, filled by later migrants, including from Ukraine. Some 1,300 people live inside hangars in Berlin's disused Nazi-era Tempelhof airport. (Photo by John MACDOUGALL / AFP) (Photo by JOHN MACDOUGALL/AFP via Getty Images)
